bio: The restoration of this former presbytery in the picturesque lanes around Sint-Martens-Bodegem Church has preserved the edifice’s authentic character, oozing in subtle charm. Diners are invited to choose from a range of amusing and unusual dishes to share, such as open sushi of river eel, Szechuan pepper and wasabi and sesame seed mayonnaise or traditional sweetbread and mushroom vol-au-vent. The intelligently curated wine list and insightful tips from the sommelier add the final flourish....
